<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bgGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9ADB7F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6EA95C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="panelGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#353843"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#181A20"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="8" stdDeviation="10" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.20"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bgGrad)"/>

  <!-- subtle top haze -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="250" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="26" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600">9:41</text>
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="316" y1="24" x2="316" y2="28" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="322" y1="22" x2="322" y2="28" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="328" y1="20" x2="328" y2="28" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="334" y1="18" x2="334" y2="28" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="341" y="18" width="18" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <rect x="359" y="21" width="2.8" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="343" y="20" width="12.5" height="6" rx="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
      <line x1="300" y1="24" x2="304" y2="24"/>
      <line x1="306" y1="20" x2="309" y2="23"/>
      <line x1="309" y1="28" x2="306" y2="25"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- App header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="68" fill="#262A34" opacity="0.18"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="18" y="58" width="34" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
      <polyline points="36,67 28,75 36,83" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <line x1="28" y1="75" x2="42" y2="75" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="78" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="600">Chat Courier</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="336" y="58" width="36" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
      <circle cx="354" cy="75" r="6.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="359" y1="80" x2="364" y2="85" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Conversation area -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <!-- date chip -->
    <rect x="137" y="126" width="116" height="24" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.90"/>
    <text x="195" y="142" text-anchor="middle" fill="#5E6272" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500">Today • 3:14 PM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Incoming bubble 1 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="168" width="220" height="70" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="30" y="190" fill="#262A34" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">Hi Marta — I’m outside the lobby.</text>
    <text x="30" y="210" fill="#5E6272" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400">Can you meet me at the side entrance?</text>
    <text x="18" y="235" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">3:14 PM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Outgoing bubble 1 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="162" y="250" width="212" height="56" rx="18" fill="#A5F59C"/>
    <text x="176" y="272" fill="#181A20" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">Perfect, I’ll be there in 2 minutes.</text>
    <text x="176" y="292" fill="#181A20" opacity="0.70" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">3:15 PM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Incoming bubble 2 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="324" width="246" height="88" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="30" y="346" fill="#262A34" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">I’ve got the parcel labels ready.</text>
    <text x="30" y="366" fill="#262A34" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">There are two boxes: one for</text>
    <text x="30" y="386" fill="#262A34" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">Avery and one for Nolan.</text>
    <text x="18" y="401" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">3:16 PM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Outgoing bubble 2 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="138" y="426" width="236" height="72" rx="18" fill="#A5F59C"/>
    <text x="152" y="448" fill="#181A20" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">Got it — I’ll check the address</text>
    <text x="152" y="468" fill="#181A20" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">on the blue package first.</text>
    <text x="152" y="489" fill="#181A20" opacity="0.70" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">3:18 PM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Incoming bubble 3 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="512" width="238" height="82" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="30" y="534" fill="#262A34" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">Thanks. Also, the customer added</text>
    <text x="30" y="554" fill="#262A34" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">a note: “Ring once, no knock.”</text>
    <text x="30" y="574" fill="#262A34" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">Please keep the receipt.</text>
    <text x="18" y="589" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">3:19 PM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Outgoing bubble 3 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="102" y="610" width="272" height="74" rx="18" fill="#A5F59C"/>
    <text x="116" y="632" fill="#181A20" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">No problem — I’ll leave a photo</text>
    <text x="116" y="652" fill="#181A20" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">proof in the thread once delivered.</text>
    <text x="116" y="673" fill="#181A20" opacity="0.70" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">3:21 PM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- typing/attachment strip -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="16" y="706" width="358" height="58" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="26" y="721" width="28" height="28" rx="14" fill="#262A34"/>
      <line x1="40" y1="727" x2="40" y2="743" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="32" y1="735" x2="48" y2="735" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    <text x="64" y="739" fill="#5E6272" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500">Type a message…</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="292" y="718" width="36" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="310" cy="735" r="10.5" fill="#A5F59C"/>
      <polygon points="308,730 316,735 308,740" fill="#181A20"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="336" y="718" width="36" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="345" y="724" width="18" height="22" rx="5" fill="#E7E7E7"/>
      <line x1="349" y1="729" x2="359" y2="729" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="349" y1="734" x2="359" y2="734" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="349" y1="739" x2="355" y2="739" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="780" width="390" height="64" fill="#181A20" opacity="0.98"/>
    <g transform="translate(18,790)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="16" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <rect x="12" y="12" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <polygon points="18,8 10,14 26,14" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <text x="18" y="44" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(94,790)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="16" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="24" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="18" y1="10" x2="18" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="18" y="44" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500">Chat</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(170,790)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="16" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="14" y1="12" x2="22" y2="20" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="22" y1="12" x2="14" y2="20" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="18" y="44" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500">Tasks</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(246,790)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="16" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="12" x2="24" y2="12" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="24" y2="16" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="20" x2="24" y2="20" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="18" y="44" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500">Menu</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(322,790)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="16" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <circle cx="18" cy="14" r="4" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <rect x="12" y="20" width="12" height="6" rx="3" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <text x="18" y="44" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500">Me</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
